item.description: Come join the Office of Inclusive Excellence on Tuesday, September 8, 2026 from 4–6 PM in the Student Success Center on the 1st Floor of Folsom Library to grab some ice cream, meet fellow students, and learn about the many services, resources, and study spaces available to support you at RPI!

item.title: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program Information Session September 9th at Noon.
item.description: The NSF GRFP provides 3 years of salary and tuition for Masters and PhD students in 30+ STEM fields. Rensselaer students earn this prestigious award every year. Seniors, and 1st year grad students (fall 2026) who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents are eligible. Email madige@rpi.edu for information or Register for the virtual information session: https://surveys.rpi.edu/jfe/form/SV_6L3FFwv0qCROrvE Come learn about the program and resources to support your application

item.title: Study Abroad & Exchange Welcome Back/Welcome!
item.description: Join Education Abroad as we welcome back the RPI students who studied abroad last semester and summer and welcome our new international exchange students here this fall from partner universities. Enjoy a slice of pizza and learn about study abroad firsthand from fellow students! Undergraduate students considering study abroad are especially encouraged to attend. Tuesday, September 8, 4:00-5:15, Bruggeman Room, CBIS. Contact: Karen Dvorak, Education Abroad Program Manager, dvorak2@rpi.edu.

item.title: Lally AI Academy Applications Now Open
item.description: Have an AI idea you want to bring to life? The Lally AI Academy is a 30-day, hands-on sprint where student teams build and deploy live AI-powered products with a $500 budget, mentorship, and professional-grade tools. No coding background required! Teams must include at least one Lally or ITWS student. Applications for Cohort 2 close September 15. Apply Today!

item.title: STS Colloquium with Ashley Shew Slated for 9/9
item.description: This talk takes us through the impetus and set up of disability-forward technology consulting. We begin by looking at disabled critiques of technology, trials in setting things up to get disabled feedback, ideas for setting up disability-forward research, and then we discuss real examples of disability consulting sessions set up by Shew through the DisCoTec Center. Come listen on 9/9 at 11:30am in Sage 5711.

item.title: Interface
item.description: September 10-November 12, 2026 Interface is a new monthly series at EMPAC that brings artists, engineers, scientists, and designers together to talk about how they actually make and think. Rather than presenting finished work, the series focuses on what happens along the way: experiments, questions, failures, intuitions, and discoveries that change the direction of a project. Series

Click the URL above to view additional information of each weekly event and URL for registration. We hope to see you there!

item.title: Cognitive Science Seminar Series: Dr. Paulo Shakarian of Syracuse University
item.description: Please join the Cognitive Science Department on Wednesday, September 9th at 12:00pm in Carnegie 113 for a seminar by Dr. Paulo Shakarian, Director of the Syracuse University Institute for Artificial Intelligence and K.G. Tan Endowed Professor of Artificial Intelligence. The seminar is titled “Metacognition: Key Findings and New Directions”.

item.title: Rob Carney Retirement Announcement and Reception
item.description: Rob Carney, Director of Campus Planning & Facilities Design, will retire on September 30, 2026, following 38 years of dedicated service to RPI. His leadership and contributions have left a lasting impact across the Institute. Please join us on Tuesday, September 29, anytime between 2:00 and 4:00 p.m. at the Heffner Alumni House, Great Room, to congratulate Rob, thank him for his many years of service, and wish him well in retirement.
item.author: Community

item.title: All Instructors - Changes for Submitting a LMS Fall 2026 Course Request
item.description: Note - Please read the entire announcement as there are changes in submitting a request due to moving to Ultra Course View. You can find Ultra Videos and documentation on our LMS support site. Instructor’s can now copy your own content from a previous semester’s course, that’s still on the LMS, into your current semester’s course, as long as you were/are the instructor in both semester courses.

item.title: 4 Steps to Effective Communication: Extended DISC
item.description: Description: Our success, both personally and professionally, is largely determined by our ability to communicate effectively with a variety of people. In this workshop, participants will receive individualized Extended DISC reports (based on the completion of the Extended DISC questionnaire) that reflect both their “natural” and adjusted.” See: https://share.percipio.com/cd/ALIOeNXsO Contact: Melissa Duquette: 518-276-3931
item.author: Faculty and Staff

item.title: Division of Human Resources Professional Development Workshop: “Coaching-Move People Forward”
item.description:
Leaders who are effective coaches create a relationship built on trust, meet the needs of those they are coaching and energize people to achieve a goal. In this seminar, participants will learn strategies for helping people move forward, grow their career and positively impact the organization. This is a two part seminar.
